title: Core scalar Cech external cup compatibility
statement: Under the coefficient and comparison hypotheses of lem-sc-picard-scalar-cech-external-cup, including the cover equalities iSup U = ⊤ and iSup V = ⊤, the displayed cycle compatibility formula holds.

proof.text: Eliminate the equality p+q=n. Define the bidegree map h to be the (p,q) tensor-summand inclusion followed by c.f (p+q). The component-coordinate hypothesis hc gives IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree for h by direct specialization.

Define t=cyclesMap c (p+q) z. Mathlib HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i and the supplied cycle inclusion equation identify its inclusion with h applied to the factor-cycle inclusions. HomologicalComplex.homologyπ_naturality identifies H(c)([z]) with [t].
Extract the ordinary module comparisons cX,cY,cP and their scalar-identification equations from heX p, heY q and heP (p+q).

Obtain the uniquely characterized ordinary module cup from exists_unique_moduleCupProduct. Apply picardModuleCech_externalPairing to h, its bidegree coordinates, the two cover equalities, the three ordinary comparisons, and the computed inclusion of t. Its conclusion is the ordinary module cup of the two pulled-back compared factor classes.

Substitute the two scalar-identification equations under moduleCohomologyPullback and the bilinear cup, using equality congruence. Substitute the product-comparison equation and homology naturality. scalarExternalCup_moduleComparison identifies the resulting ordinary cup with externalCup of the factor scalar classes. Transitivity completes the equality; substitution of n already removed the degree cast.

lean.statement:
theorem picardScalarCech_externalCup_core
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens)
    (hUc : iSup U = ⊤) (hVc : iSup V = ⊤)
    (c : HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F)
        ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G) (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ) ⟶
      (picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
    (hc : IsPicardExternalCechCupComponent f g U V F G c)
    (eX : ∀ p : ℕ, ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).homology p →ₗ[k]
      scalarCohomology f F p)
    (heX : ∀ p, IsPicardScalarCechComparison f U F p (eX p))
    (eY : ∀ q : ℕ, ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).homology q →ₗ[k]
      scalarCohomology g G q)
    (heY : ∀ q, IsPicardScalarCechComparison g V G q (eY q))
    (eP : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj
            (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).homology n →ₗ[k]
        scalarCohomology (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) n)
    (heP : ∀ n, IsPicardScalarCechComparison (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
      (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
        pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) n (eP n)) :
    let A := (picardCechFunctor f U).obj F
    let B := (picardCechFunctor g V).obj G
    let T := HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n})
    (a : A.cycles i.val.1) (v : B.cycles i.val.2) (z : T.cycles n),
    T.iCycles n z = HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor A B
        (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) i.val.1 i.val.2 n
        i.property ((A.iCycles i.val.1 a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles i.val.2 v)) →
      eP n (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c n (T.homologyπ n z)) =
        cast (congrArg (fun d ↦ ↥(scalarCohomology (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
          (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) d)) i.property)
          (externalCup f g F G i.val.1 i.val.2
            (eX i.val.1 (A.homologyπ _ a)) (eY i.val.2 (B.homologyπ _ v)))

statement_change.old_statement: Under the coefficient and comparison hypotheses of lem-sc-picard-scalar-cech-external-cup, without the cover equalities, the displayed cycle compatibility formula holds.
statement_change.what: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: the old core omitted cover equalities. On X=Y=P¹_k with rational points x₀,x₁, the singleton families U=V=P¹_k\{x₁} omit x₁. For F=G=k(x₀)⊕k(x₁), the factor comparison can extend s to (s,0), while the product comparison extends s to (s,s,s,s). Their restriction comparison equations see only x₀ and (x₀,x₀); the factor external cup at 1 is (1,0,0,0), whereas the product extension is (1,1,1,1). Both global structure rings are k, so these extensions are linear. Restore the cover equalities already present in the unchanged enclosing theorem. This geometric counterexample is described in the supplied G3 route audit; it is not claimed as a fully formalized Lean scheme counterexample.

old_proof.text: Fix the displayed degree, summand, cycles and total cycle. Expand the refinement and Alexander–Whitney coordinates and use the comparison witnesses; scalar restriction identifies the resulting cup with externalCup.
